semiconductor_relevance: High — Bueno Technology specializes in flow control products essential for maintaining cleanroom environments in semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Bueno Technology Co., Ltd. manufactures high-purity flow control products, including valves and fittings, specifically designed for cleanroom applications in the semiconductor industry. With over 40 years of experience, they prioritize safety and reliability in their products, catering to the needs of various high-tech sectors.

regional_presence.Taiwan: Bueno Technology has manufacturing facilities in Taiwan, contributing to its reputation as a leading brand in the region.
regional_presence.Shanghai: The company operates a manufacturing site in Shanghai, enhancing its production capabilities.
regional_presence.Vietnam: Bueno Technology also has a presence in Vietnam, supporting its manufacturing and export operations.
